Schedule 1—Classes of visa

1108 Child (Migrant) (Class AH)

(1) Form: The approved form specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for this item under subregulation 2.07(5).

(3) Other: An application must be made at the place, and in the manner, specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for this item under subregulation 2.07(5).

(4) Subclasses:

101 (Child)

102 (Adoption)

Schedule 2—Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas

Subclass 102—Adoption

102.2—Primary criteria

102.22—Criteria to be satisfied at time of decision

102.221

The applicant satisfies public interest criteria 4001, 4002, 4003, 4004, 4007, 4009 and 4020.

102.222

The applicant satisfies public interest criterion 4019 and the requirements of subclause 102.221(1).

102.611

The visa is subject to conditions 8501 and 8515.
